messages:
Kai: 🎉 Heads up team — just got the final numbers and we officially hit 10x ARR this quarter. From $2.1M to ~$21M ARR. I am floored. Huge thanks to everyone. Pizza + kazoos to celebrate Friday? :confetti_ball:
Jordan: OMG WHAT!!! 🤯 That's insane, congrats!! Where do we sign up for pizza?
Priya: Amazing news!! Can we make sure there's a gf/vegan option pls 🙏
Marta: Love this. Also can we do a 2-min 'wins' mic so folks can shout outs? Short and sweet.
Karen (people-ops): Count me in. I'll order food — dietary survey in 1 min. Also can we get a small budget for kazoo procurement? 😄
Kai: @Karen amazing, thank you. Budget approved from my side. 3pm Friday in the kitchen + lounge. Quick toast and team photo.
Jordan: I'll bring my ridiculous unicorn kazoo collection 🦄
Priya: I'll bring cookies (gluten-free batch in labelled box). Also shoutout to infra and onboarding for the last sprint — y'all crushed it.
Marta: Shoutout to @DevEx for the new quickstart templates too — lowered friction for a ton of POCs.
milestone-bot: :tada: milestone-bot: Redwood Inference hit 10x ARR milestone — congrats, team! 🎊
Kai: Low-key planning a tiny 'kudos wall' with sticky notes for people to put shoutouts during the party. If you want to add something beforehand DM me.
Jordan: Photo idea: people with kazoos + confetti cannons? (confetti cannons may be noisy, but iconic) :camera_with_flash:
Priya: Confetti cannons = yes but maybe outside? 😂
Marta: Can we also invite remote folks via a quick Zoom window so they can join the toast?
Kai: Absolutely — we'll set up a camera and drop a Zoom link in #all-hands at 2:45pm Friday. Remote peeps get cake emoji and a kazoo emoji in their honor.
Karen (people-ops): Survey sent. Please fill in dietary + remote attendance by EOD Wednesday.
Jordan: Filled it out. Also, can we get sparkly napkins? :sparkles:
Priya: Done. Also small request: can we have a 1-minute recognition for the ops folks who handled the surge last month? They deserve it.
Kai: 100% — ops recognition is on the program.
Marta: This is such a great milestone. Feeling proud and caffeinated ☕️
Kai: Same. Huge thanks again. See you Friday (kazoo practice optional but encouraged). :heart:
